# Charred bone

Type: Material | Internal ID: CharredBone | Source: Charred Warrior, ,, Charred Marksman, ,, Charred Warlock, ,, Charred Twitcher | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Charred bone is an item used for many of the Ashlands-tier weapons and armor.
Like Bone fragments, Charred bone can be used to power a Shield generator.

## Availability

• Dropped by Charred Warriors, Charred Marksmen, Charred Warlocks, and Charred Twitchers.
